rows.name: Rashid Shaheed
rows.comment: Shaheed caught one pass for eight yards on two targets in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Raiders.

rows.name: Drew Lock
rows.comment: Lock completed 14 of 17 passes for 240 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions and logged six carries for 20 yards during Sunday's 21-13 victory in Las Vegas.

rows.name: Jadarian Price
rows.comment: Price posted nine carries for 36 yards and one touchdown and gathered in his only target for eight yards during Sunday's 21-13 victory at Las Vegas.

rows.name: Zach Charbonnet
rows.comment: Charbonnet churned out 94 yards on 20 carries during Sunday's 21-13 win in Las Vegas.

rows.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
rows.comment: Smith-Njigba gathered in eight of 10 targets for 171 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 21-13 win at Las Vegas.

rows.name: Jarran Reed
rows.comment: Reed is doubtful to return to Sunday's game against Las Vegas due to a toe injury.

rows.name: Abraham Lucas
rows.comment: Lucas (ankle) is doubtful to return to Sunday's game against the Raiders.

rows.name: Emanuel Wilson
rows.comment: Wilson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game at Arizona.

rows.name: Brandon Pili
rows.comment: Pili (back) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Raiders, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

rows.name: Uchenna Nwosu
rows.comment: Nwosu (ankle) does not have an injury designation against the Raiders on Sunday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

rows.name: Derick Hall
rows.comment: Hall (back) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Raiders, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

rows.name: Baker Mayfield
rows.comment: Mayfield (thumb) is dealing with a plantar fascia injury in his foot, and he would wear a special orthotic and new cleats to stabilize his foot if he's cleared to play against the Lions on Sunday, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports.

rows.name: Josh Hayes
rows.comment: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions.

rows.name: Yaya Diaby
rows.comment: Diaby (knee) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions.

rows.name: Antoine Winfield Jr.
rows.comment: Winfield (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions.

rows.name: Jalon Daniels
rows.comment: Head coach Todd Bowles expressed optimism Friday that Baker Mayfield (foot/thumb) will start against the Lions on Sunday, which would leave Daniels as the Buccaneers' QB2, Scott Smith and Brianna Dix of the team's official site report.

rows.name: Easton Stick
rows.comment: The Buccaneers signed Stick off their practice squad Monday, Scott Smith of the team's official site reports.

rows.name: Tykee Smith
rows.comment: Smith recorded seven tackles (four solo) and an interception in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

rows.name: Zyon McCollum
rows.comment: McCollum recorded five tackles (four solo) and two interceptions in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

rows.name: Alex Anzalone
rows.comment: Anzalone posted two solo tackles and an interception during the Buccaneers' 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.

rows.name: Josiah Trotter
rows.comment: Trotter recorded eight tackles (five solo) during the Buccaneers' 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.

rows.name: Kameron Johnson
rows.comment: Johnson played all 17 of his snaps on special teams and recorded one tackle in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

rows.name: Ted Hurst III
rows.comment: Hurst failed to haul in his lone target during the Buccaneers' 27-24 loss to the Bears on Sunday.

rows.name: Tez Johnson
rows.comment: Johnson caught two passes for 76 yards on five targets in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

rows.name: Sean Tucker
rows.comment: Tucker didn't log any offensive snaps in a loss to the Bears on Sunday. He returned four kickoffs for 92 yards.

rows.name: Chase McLaughlin
rows.comment: McLaughlin converted all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during Tampa Bay's loss to the Bears on Sunday.

rows.name: Cade Otton
rows.comment: Otton caught four of eight targets for 25 yards in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

rows.name: Bucky Irving
rows.comment: Head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that the Buccaneers "will try and lessen the load" on Irving following their Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

rows.name: Jalen McMillan
rows.comment: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

rows.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
rows.comment: Godwin caught two of three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard rush during Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

rows.name: Kenny Gainwell
rows.comment: Gainwell rushed five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

rows.name: Emeka Egbuka
rows.comment: Egbuka (foot) caught three of five targets for 38 yards and added a one-yard run in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

rows.name: Jaylen Harrell
rows.comment: Harrell (knee) was taken to a hospital in Tampa following a serious car accident, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

rows.name: Tony Adams
rows.comment: Adams has cleared the league's concussion protocol and no longer carries an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Michael Carter
rows.comment: The Titans elevated Carter from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Tyjae Spears
rows.comment: The Titans placed Spears (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Carnell Tate
rows.comment: Tate (shoulder) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys but is "considered likely" to be cleared to play, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

rows.name: Micah Robinson
rows.comment: questionable

rows.name: Kevin Winston Jr.
rows.comment: Winston (shoulder) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

rows.name: Anthony Hill Jr.
rows.comment: Hill (neck) is questionable to face the Cowboys on Sunday.

rows.name: Cody Barton
rows.comment: Barton (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against Dallas.

rows.name: John Franklin-Myers
rows.comment: Franklin-Myers (back) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

rows.name: Cedric Gray
rows.comment: Gray posted nine tackles (eight solo) and two pass defenses (including an interception) during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars in Week 10.

rows.name: Fernando Carmona
rows.comment: The Titans designated Carmona (ankle) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

rows.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
rows.comment: Coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday that Robinson (ankle) -- who was placed on IR on Tuesady -- is out for the rest of the season, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

rows.name: Julius Chestnut
rows.comment: Chestnut played all 25 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Jaguars.

rows.name: Xavier Restrepo
rows.comment: Restrepo, whom the Titans signed off their practice squad Tuesday, could be in store for more playing time out of the slot moving forward after Tennessee placed Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve, Mark Mihalko of USA Today reports.

rows.name: Chimere Dike
rows.comment: Dike caught two passes for 16 yards on three targets in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars. He added five rushing yards on one attempt.

rows.name: Daniel Bellinger
rows.comment: Bellinger caught two of three targets for six yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

rows.name: Joey Slye
rows.comment: Slye made all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also logged a tackle and forced a fumble.

rows.name: Calvin Ridley
rows.comment: Ridley played four offensive snaps and didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

rows.name: Gunnar Helm
rows.comment: Helm caught all four of his targets for 23 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

rows.name: Elic Ayomanor
rows.comment: Ayomanor caught five of 10 targets for 79 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

rows.name: Lucas Patrick
rows.comment: Patrick (concussion) is questionable for Monday's game against the Bengals.

rows.name: Quan Martin
rows.comment: Martin (shoulder) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Bengals.

rows.name: Amik Robertson
rows.comment: Robertson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Bengals.

rows.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
rows.comment: Croskey-Merritt (groin) is slated to be activated from IR in time to play in Monday's game against the Bengals, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

rows.name: Treylon Burks
rows.comment: Burks (foot) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Bengals.

rows.name: Rachaad White
rows.comment: White (heel) is listed as questionable for Monday's game versus the Bengals.

rows.name: Laremy Tunsil
rows.comment: Tunsil (triceps) is progressing well in his recovery but is not expected to return by the end of the 2026 regular season, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

rows.name: Colson Yankoff
rows.comment: Yankoff (knee) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

rows.name: Luke McCaffrey
rows.comment: McCaffrey returned two punts for 13 yards and three kickoffs for 58 yards in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.

rows.name: Jeremy Reaves
rows.comment: Reaves recorded nine tackles (seven solo), one pass defense and one fumble recovery during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Nick Cross
rows.comment: Cross finished Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants with six tackles (one solo).

rows.name: Frankie Luvu
rows.comment: Luvu recorded six tackles (two solo) and a forced fumble during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Sonny Styles
rows.comment: Styles recorded 13 tackles (five solo) during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Drew Stevens
rows.comment: Stevens made his only field-goal attempt and was successful on all three of his extra-point tries in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.

rows.name: Ben Sinnott
rows.comment: Sinnott caught all four of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown Thursday in a 24-21 victory against the Giants.

rows.name: Antonio Williams
rows.comment: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Austin Ekeler
rows.comment: Ekeler rushed nine times for 26 yards and brought in all four targets for 26 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Stefon Diggs
rows.comment: Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Jayden Daniels
rows.comment: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Chig Okonkwo
rows.comment: Okonkwo (back) returned to Thursday's eventual 24-21 win at the Giants, finishing with four catches (on eight targets) for 24 yards.
